milestones.title: S0
milestones.description: Tell the truth: honest README and a project that boots

milestones.title: S1
milestones.description: Real pipeline: claim check, FFmpeg, HLS

issues.title: README describes capabilities the project does not have
issues.goal: The public README claims real transcoding and scale that do not exist.
done: The README states only what the code does
Simulated parts are labelled as simulated

issues.title: Add the roadmap, backlog and workflow documents
issues.goal: Record the plan in the repository.
done: `docs/ROADMAP.md`, `docs/WORKFLOW.md` and `docs/backlog.json` are on `develop`

issues.title: Two application classes break packaging
issues.goal: Keep one Spring Boot application class, and move the context test into its package.
done: `package` produces a runnable jar
The context test loads the real application

issues.title: Database URL is hardcoded and topics need three brokers
issues.goal: Move configuration to properties and make topic replicas configurable.
done: JDBC settings come from configuration
Topics are created on a single broker

issues.title: Boot the application against Docker Compose
issues.goal: One command for Kafka, Postgres and MinIO.
done: The application boots on a clean clone against Compose
CI runs verify

issues.title: Remove adaptive, session and user code
issues.goal: Delete code that the roadmap places out of scope.
done: The project builds without those packages

issues.title: Upload to MinIO and publish references, not bytes
done: No topic carries video bytes
An object without a database row is cleaned up

issues.title: Transcode with FFmpeg in an attempt-scoped worker
issues.goal: Real HLS at two renditions, with the manifest written last and the partition paused during long jobs.
done: ffprobe validates two renditions in an end-to-end test
A job longer than `max.poll.interval.ms` does not trigger a rebalance

issues.title: Serve the HLS manifest and verify playback
issues.goal: A sample video plays in a browser (K7).
done: Playwright confirms hls.js playback

issues.title: Publish events through a transactional outbox
issues.goal: A database commit and its event cannot diverge.
done: A relay crash between publish and mark-sent loses nothing

issues.title: Make event handling effect-once
issues.goal: Redelivery never produces a second READY transition or catalog row (K2).
done: K2 holds after forced redelivery
Re-executions are reported (K3)

issues.title: Add bounded retries and dead-letter topics
issues.goal: A poison event cannot block a partition (K5).
done: Malformed events reach the DLT and the partition keeps moving

issues.title: Build the crash test harness
issues.goal: Kill the worker and the relay during a run and verify K1 and K2.
done: K1 and K2 are published from one command

issues.title: Add metrics and a consumer lag dashboard
issues.goal: Lag, throughput and failures are visible.
done: The dashboard ships with Compose

issues.title: Publish recovery and scaling results
issues.goal: K4 and K6 with real FFmpeg under CPU limits.
done: Results are published with the hardware used
